verdict.rationale: LightSprint has human approval gates: teams pick options and mockups before a build (docs-6), review screenshots and recordings before approving (docs-21), and see a plain-English summary plus the diff (docs-20). Agents run in background cloud sandboxes (docs-11, docs-14), and Slack task creation with two-way sync (docs-26) could be a remote touchpoint. Nothing shows mobile access, a phone approval flow, or approval of mid-run agent decisions while agents keep working, since approvals appear to happen at the plan or PR stage. Missing for 10: a mobile app or documented phone approval experience, notifications or approval requests for key agent decisions during a run, explicit non-blocking approval while agents continue, and independent corroboration.
